Start in Key Lento. Flip the power lever upstairs and press the button to display the Malibu Club logo. The 12 LPL substations spell LIFE IS PASSING ME BY, the Vice City cheat that sped up the clock. Visit them in order. Fast travel and switching characters reset the sequence.
Downtown Vice City. Step 1 of 12. Press the button marked D.
Balsero. Step 2 of 12. Press the button marked D.
Key Lento. Step 3 of 12. Press the button marked • (dot).
North Vice Beach. Step 4 of 12. Press the button marked A.
North Vice City. Step 5 of 12. Pull the lever marked • (dot).
Port Gellhorn. Step 6 of 12. Pull the lever marked A.
Hamlet. Step 7 of 12. Press the button marked A.
Gloriana Key. Step 8 of 12. Press the button marked A.
Hamlet. Step 9 of 12. Pull the lever marked • (dot).
Port Gellhorn. Step 10 of 12. Pull the lever marked W.
Hamlet. Step 11 of 12. Pull the lever marked D.
Near Breakwater Quarry, southwest of Vice City International Airport. Step 12 of 12. Pull the lever marked W.

LPL Tortoise Head Power Station, east of Hamlet. After the text “U-235 REACTOR2 19-06” arrives, enter Reactor 2 as Jason between 19:00 and 06:00 in-game. The portal leads to the classic Malibu Club and Kent Paul. Returning unlocks Tommy Vercetti’s shirt and the Malibu Zombie Bobber.
Browse the yard sale in Port Gellhorn during the day for the cowboy hat from Red Dead Redemption 2.
Go around to the back of the hotel in Crosstown. Look for the red numbers as you explore the upper floors.
Come alone at night and look for flashing lights on the roadside. If the car appears, follow the trail into the woods.
Talk to Jose Bermudez at the memorial. Follow his lead to the apartment in Little Cuba and listen to the recording.
Enter 010317 at the door. Restore power and listen to the recordings to find the clue for the next bunker.
The entrance opens from the keypad on the tree. The code from the photograph is 085355.
Explore the Pelican Valley station. Restore power at the back of the building and check the lab computer.
The code for the boathouse is in the laboratory safe.
Search the woods south of Cottonmouth Lake. The encounter leads into the swamp, where there is an effigy.
Look for Kirk's flyer at Skeeter's in Hamlet to follow his investigation.
Follow the trail up to the fire lookout near Moreau and inspect the cabin.
The pin marks the mine entrance. There are piles of bones farther inside.
For the first visit, look for the tunnel under the shipping container on the east side. Reach the intercom at the bunker door.
